faq.q: Do I pay property tax on a manufactured home in a Langley park?
faq.a: Yes, on the home: the Province states a manufactured home owner is assessed and taxed like other residential property owners, but the assessed value does not include the value of the land where the home is in a manufactured home park not on reserve land, or on land privately owned by someone other than the home owner.
